/**
 * Data models for the Nullability API (spec version 1.0.0).
 */
import type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue } from '../core/json.js';

export type { BinaryInput, JsonObject, JsonValue };

/**
 * Declares additionalProperties, so unmodelled keys must survive.
 */
export interface Envelope {
  id: string;
  label?: string;
  /**
   * Additional free-form properties (`JsonValue` on the wire).
   */
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

/**
 * Every shape of optionality the spec uses.
 */
export interface Thing {
  id: string;
  /**
   * Present but may be null.
   */
  required_nullable: string | null;
  count: number;
  optional_plain?: number;
  optional_nullable?: boolean | null;
  legacy_nullable?: JsonObject | null;
  created_at?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  free_form?: JsonObject;
  anything?: JsonObject;
  /**
   * @deprecated
   */
  deprecated_field?: string;
  kind?: 'thing';
}

import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';

import type {
  Envelope,

/**
 * Operations tagged `Things`.
 */
export class ThingsResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * Fetch a thing
   *
   * `GET /things/{thingId}`
   *
   * Required scopes: `things:read`.
   */
  get(thingId: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Thing> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/things/${encodeURIComponent(String(thingId))}`,
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * `GET /envelopes`
   */
  listEnvelopes(options?: RequestOptions): Promise<Envelope> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: '/envelopes',
      options,
    });
  }
}
